escena: SCENE (cinematic, closing shot, the last frame of a film, epic scale): a vast dark corporate hall at night. On both sides of the frame, rows of tall dead grey screens stand switched off, dusty and dim, showing faint faded remains of an old, generic corporate look: the previous chapter. In the center of the far wall, about twelve meters away, a monumental tall doorway has just opened in the dark wall, and through it pours a blazing new world made of light: a bold, vivid brand universe of sweeping orange (#FF6500) forms, deep navy planes and one huge vertical film frame, so bright it is the only real light of the scene. A Latin American woman executive in her early forties, dark hair in a low ponytail, in a tailored charcoal suit (no logos), walks toward the doorway, seen FROM BEHIND, small in the frame (about one fifth of the frame height), mid-stride, her long shadow stretching back toward the lens across the floor. The light from the doorway outlines her silhouette with a thin orange rim and spills along the floor toward the camera. Camera low, about eight meters behind her at waist height, 50mm, symmetrical, centered composition. On the dead screens, tiny azure (#0375DB) standby lights glow faintly, the only cool color in the hall. Thin haze hangs in the hall and catches the beams that fan out from the doorway. The doorway and the light world rise only up to 64% of the frame height measured from the bottom: the TOP 30% of the frame is calm, deep dark ceiling space with faint haze, no light, no beams, no objects. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand.

lecho.objeto: the dark matte concrete floor in the lowest fifth of the frame, close to the lens and out of focus, outside the spill of the doorway light and its reflection

texto.muro: calm, deep dark ceiling space with only faint haze
